column4: Duplicates item 3, as it describes the same body of Islamic scholars.
Gloss 'relating' is meaningless and merely repeats the other two Uzbek meanings.
The gloss 'action' is vague, and the meaning duplicates 'action of bending' and 'reversal' already listed.
Archaic and duplicates the "to demarcate" meaning of item 3.
to pull around is a literal sense that overlaps with the other listed meanings and adds nothing for a learner.
Archaic "to surround" duplicates "to demarcate"/going around and only confuses learners.
Archaic "to travel around" duplicates the existing "to go around" meaning.
'To toss over' and 'to rumple' largely duplicate the other omwoelen sense of turning things over and are obscure.
'To swarm around' essentially duplicates meaning 1 of omzwermen.
Duplicate of the other omzweven meaning; 'hover around' and 'glide around' overlap.
The Roman catapult meaning is archaic and obscure, and it only confuses a learner; the main entry covers the word.
'Slave' is not what onderhorige means; it is a dependent or subordinate person, and that sense is covered by the other entry.
'Irreligious' is not a meaning of ondermaans; it is a wrong sense.
'To suppress' is not a real meaning of onderschikken, and the correct sense is covered by the subordinate entry.
'To stay in the boundary' is not a real meaning of onderschrijden; the word means to fall below a limit.
Onderspannen is a rare technical term (to subtend in geometry, to stretch tight underneath), and 'to tighten' is wrong; the learner gains little from it.
Onderstromen is an obscure, rarely used verb and 'to flood' is not a real meaning; it duplicates the other entry in being unreliable.
Archaic word, and its glosses 'prose' and 'work of prose' are duplicates, so one entry is enough and this one is dropped.
'Barren' is not a real meaning of ongastvrij; the word means inhospitable, which is listed as another meaning.
'Distant' is essentially a repeat of 'unapproachable', so it is a duplicate.
The archaic sense 'start to become green' is obscure and the real sense (to haze) is already listed as another meaning.
'To untemper' is not a real meaning of ontharden and only duplicates or confuses the water-softening sense.
'Rememberer' is not a natural Dutch meaning of onthouder (that would be a verb sense of onthouden); it is a spurious meaning and learners would be confused.
'To occur' duplicates 'to develop' for the reflexive sense of ontspinnen.
'To remove spiders' is not a real meaning of ontspinnen; it appears to be a made-up compositional reading.

column3: to remove a stalk from fruit
column4: Removing a stalk is ontstelen in the sense of 'ontstelen' from 'steel' (stalk), but it is obscure and confusing next to the common meaning, so drop it.
'To steal' duplicates 'to deprive' (ontstelen = steal away from someone), so it is a repeat of the kept meaning.
Archaic verb; 'ontstrijden' meaning to take away by fighting is obscure and confuses learners, while 'to challenge' is dubious too.
'Ontvaren' means to sail away/depart by ship, an obscure archaic word; 'to escape' is a dubious, overlapping sense, so drop it and keep the other.
Duplicates the other meaning; both describe the same feigning/concealing sense of the verb.
Near-duplicate of 'to ignite'; ontvonken means to ignite/spark, so one entry suffices.
Duplicates the other meaning; both describe ending guardianship.
Near-duplicate of the 'to devalue' meaning; ontwaarden means to lose or reduce value, and the quality example does not fit.
Rare, literary verb whose sense 'to start to flow' is essentially the same as 'to well (up)', so it duplicates the other meaning.
Ontwoekeren is a rare, archaic verb for freeing someone from usury; 'remove overgrowth' is not a real meaning and the other entry covers the actual sense.
Ontwringen means to wrest away from someone; 'to escape by twisting' is not a real meaning and the sense overlaps with the other listed meanings.
Ontzeilen as 'to escape by sailing' is not an established meaning and is obscure; only a rare nautical sense exists.
Ontzetting for 'dislocation' is a rare medical sense (ontwrichting is the normal word) and only confuses learners.
'Enthusiastic' is not the real meaning and overlaps with the other sense of tireless/diligent.
'Undesired' is not a real meaning of onwelvoeglijk, which means indecent or improper, so it is covered by the other entry.
Onzienlijk never meant 'ugly' in current Dutch, and this is an archaic meaning that would only confuse learners.
'Without being seen' only repeats the meaning 'invisible'.
'All gone' duplicates the other listed meanings (up, used up), and the example 'time's up' fits the 'up' meaning already listed.
The gloss is just a Dutch synonym and the meaning 'opaque' is already listed, so this is a duplicate.
'To flower' duplicates 'to bloom' for the same verb.
'To open with effort' is obscure and overlaps with the other openwerken sense of working something open, so it only confuses a learner.
'Ridge' is not a real meaning of ophoging; the raised-land sense is covered by the raising meaning.
Opkalefateren means to patch up or do up shabbily, so 'to improve' is a loose duplicate of the other meaning.
Mindfulness is essentially a repeat of attentiveness, and 'opmerkzaamheid' is mainly attentiveness (or a small gesture), so this duplicates the other meaning.
'To bring stones' is an obscure dialect/technical sense that only confuses learners.
'To cock hay' is an archaic agricultural meaning that is obscure for learners; 'to suggest' remains.
Opsouperen means to use up or squander, so this gloss overlaps with the other meanings 'to use up' and 'to waste'.
Opsouperen means to spend/squander on food and drink, so 'use up (allowance, quota)' is a spurious duplicate of the waste/squander meanings.
Duplicates the other optater meaning (hard hit = resounding blow); keep the entry that has the example.
Optatie is an obscure formal term, and "optation" is not a real English gloss; it duplicates the other meaning "choosing".
Opteren does not mean to rot away; this meaning does not exist.
to windlass is an obscure non-word and the meaning duplicates "to crank up"; opvijzelen means to jack up/raise, already covered.
Opzien does not mean to supervise (that is "toezien" or "opzichter"); the real meanings are already listed among the other meanings.
Orgelpunt means a pedal point (music) or a fermata/hold, not 'climax', so this wrong meaning is dropped and the other entry is fixed.
overbeladen is a participle/adjective meaning overloaded, and the verb senses 'to burden', 'to overcharge' and 'to pack' overlap each other, so this one is a duplicate.
Overdrachtelijk does not mean transitive; that is "overgankelijk", so this meaning does not exist.
Overroepen does not mean to shout excessively; the real sense is to shout over someone, which is kept in the other entry.
'Excessively shout' is not the meaning of overschreeuwen; it is a faulty gloss and duplicates the shouting sense.
Cutting excessively is not a real meaning of oversnijden; it is a made-up sense.
'To excessively stimulate' is not a real meaning of overvoeren; it duplicates the overfeed sense.
To import in excess is not a real meaning of overvoeren; it is a spurious sense (overvoeren means to overfeed or to transfer).
'Pertaining to native' is a garbled fragment of the dialect sense and is not a real separate meaning.
The dialect sense is essentially covered by the Pajottenland sense, so it is a near duplicate.
Parabool does not mean 'understatement' (that would be 'understatement' or 'litotes'); it is a mistaken meaning, perhaps confused with parabel (parable).
It duplicates the other parnassia entry, which already gives the more informative gloss.
The meaning duplicates the other listed meaning 'passive voice'.
Penant means the wall section between two windows (pier), not a pedestal, so this meaning is wrong.
Penisnijd means penis envy only; the 'macho rivalry' meaning does not exist and the real meaning is already listed.
Gloss 'corresponding' is wrong for petrochemie and the real meaning is already listed as petrochemistry.
wiry and "sinewy" are near-synonyms for pezig, so this meaning duplicates the other one.
Best achievement of an author duplicates the masterwork meaning, so it is dropped.
It is a vague duplicate of the stingray meaning in item 1.
The literal tarred breeches sense is rare and archaic; the word is only really known as a slang term for sailor, which is listed separately.
Pimpelen does not mean 'to blink'; that sense is not attested and is probably a confusion with knipperen or pinken.
Sipping is an archaic sense that only overlaps with the tippling meaning and would confuse a learner.
Pingelen does not mean to knock; that sense is not standard and is covered loosely by the ringing sense.
Pingelen meaning to play music is not a real sense and the vulgar label is unfounded.
'Campshedding' is a obscure, unrelated meaning for plaatwerk and is not a real sense learners need; the word means sheet metal work.
Duplicates 'to provide with a ceiling', the actual plastering meaning of plafonneren.
Plagerij means teasing or harassment, not worry, and the teasing meaning is already listed.
Pleisteren is a verb, not an adjective; the verb meanings are listed under the verb entry, so this is a wrong-type duplicate.
Pleisteren is not an adjective; the plaster meaning is already listed under the verb.
The gloss 'one who speaks' is poor and the meaning duplicates the existing 'advocate' meaning.
'To insert with force' is essentially a repeat of the flinging meaning and adds nothing distinct for a learner.
'Completely random' is not a real meaning of plompverloren; it duplicates the other sense of 'lost, wasted'.
'Shitter' is essentially a duplicate of the other poeper meaning (anus/backside), so it is redundant.
Pomerans does not mean felt; this meaning does not exist for the word.
The American-populism sense is too narrow and just duplicates the general 'populist' meaning already listed.
'Lewd' is a loose paraphrase that duplicates the existing 'pornographic' meaning.
to carry out is a loose sense that overlaps with the practising/observing meanings and adds little for a learner.
The sense 'avowal' (professie as a declaration of faith or vows) is obscure and archaic for learners, and the main meaning 'profession' is already listed.
Prove (levenslang onderhoud, gift) is an archaic word; the sense is obscure and overlaps with the other meaning, so it only confuses a learner.
Serving is not a meaning of provocatief; the real senses are covered by the other entries.
'Reddish purple' is essentially a repeat of 'purple' for the same adjective.
The archaic 'throw of three dice' sense is obscure and only confuses a learner, while the frayed thread meaning is the useful one.
This duplicates the other ramsj meaning; 'sale of new' is not a distinct sense and the other entry covers it.
The surform tool is essentially a rasp-type file, so it largely duplicates the grater meaning and is a narrow technical sense.

column3: book with prescriptions in a pharmacy
column4: Receptenboek means recipe book; the pharmacy prescriptions meaning is an obscure sense that duplicates or confuses the other meaning.
Redeneerkunde means logic, not rhetoric (that is redekunst), so this meaning is wrong and overlaps with the logic meaning.
'Relating to a rekel' is a vague, rare, circular gloss that only duplicates the scampish meaning.
The sense 'vague' is a loose overlap with flexible and not a real separate meaning of rekkelijk.
Asceticism is not a real meaning of renunciatie; the other entry 'renunciation' covers the word.
Odd is not a meaning of resterend, which only means remaining.
Misspelled and redundant gloss that duplicates the general meaning of retention (memory/retaining ability).
Remembrance is an obscure sense that essentially duplicates retention (memory) and only confuses learners.
Ground rent is not a real meaning of retributie (that would be erfpacht), and it is obscure and confusing.
Discovery duplicates the revelation sense, which covers a surprising discovery.
Riant does not mean 'decisive'; it means cheerful/pleasant or generous/spacious, so this meaning does not exist.
'Exactly' is not a real meaning of rigoureus and the adverb sense duplicates 'rigorously'.
Coruler is a rare and doubtful sense of rijksgenoot, which really means someone from the same realm (listed separately), so it only confuses learners.
Gloss 'national' is meaningless for this noun and duplicates the corrected mint meaning.
The gloss 'belonging' is wrong and the real meaning Ripuarian is already listed in the other entry.
'Rhythmics' is essentially the same meaning as meaning 1 and only duplicates it.
